blurb: Guests can rent canoes, kayaks, or tubes to paddle or float down scenic stretches of the Huron River. Trips launch each hour, morning and afternoon, with shuttle service to the launch point and paddling back at your own pace. The facility operates within Metroparks in Dexter and Ann Arbor, MI, requiring a daily or annual park permit.

quotes.text: Everything was exactly as promised. They were super friendly and able to answer any and all questions. All of the equipment was clean and well maintained. They were also doing an excellent job balancing all of the requirements and challenges that COVID present. We are hands down planning on going back.

Best place to spend a warm 3 hour+ afternoon. The tubs are cleaned and sanitized after each use. We had 8 people with 8 tubes that we tried together and had a wonderful family experience. Just remember to spend the 30 minutes signing all the safety waivers online before you leave home.

A great day on the river! Today was a fast flow so make sure you grab a paddle or two. We had so much fun and met new friends! Don't forget your water socks, much appreciated if you get off your tube. A great time and worth the money. Great customer service..we will be back!!!! ❤

quotes.author: R. Richmond
quotes.text: Had a fantastic experience doing the “long trip” with Skip’s. The team was friendly, on time, and very responsive. We had a fantastic trip down the Huron, with lovely scenery and even some wildlife! Cannot recommend this activity highly enough!! Loved it!

What a great experience -> 3 times so far!! The entire process is simple, efficient and staff is super friendly!! Can’t wait to float the river in the fall when the leaves are changing and the smell of fresh donuts from the cider mill fills the air….

Had a fun and relaxing day couple of hours on the water! I've been kayaking several times, and this was by far the best time. Friendly staff, self-explanatory directions, and a nice distance trip that gives plenty of time to still relax on the water.
